name: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
description: A plate-loaded seated row with a narrow grip, one arm at a time for balanced back strength.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.
